strings.curiosity.triangolo.fact: There are 88 official constellations, chosen by astronomers all over the world!
strings.curiosity.cassiopea.fact: Cassiopeia was a queen from ancient stories: her W of stars still shines every night.
strings.curiosity.cigno.fact: The Swan flies across the summer sky with its stars shaped like a big cross.
strings.curiosity.carro.fact: The two stars on the edge of the Big Dipper point the way to the North Star!
strings.curiosity.leone.fact: The Lion is a very ancient constellation: people have watched it for thousands of years.
strings.curiosity.orione.fact: The stars of a constellation look close together, but many are really far, far apart!
strings.victory.title: What a magical sky!
strings.victory.subtitle: You lit up the whole night sky!
